audiences.name: Chemists
audiences.description: Professional chemists requiring precise terminology, nomenclature context, and source-bound reference.
audiences.tone_complexity_constraints: Precise, source-cited, no prescriptive safety or handling.
audiences.safety_medical_market_restrictions: No safety instructions, medical claims, or unsourced market data.

audiences.name: Researchers
audiences.description: Academic and industrial researchers needing provenance, claim boundaries, and multilingual terminology context.
audiences.safety_medical_market_restrictions: No safety prescription, medical claims, or unsourced statistics.

audiences.name: Economic analysts
audiences.description: Analysts interpreting document language, market context, and terminology in economic or trade documents.
audiences.tone_complexity_constraints: Analytical framing only; market data requires verified market_report sources.
audiences.safety_medical_market_restrictions: Market claims only with verified sources; no investment recommendations.

audiences.name: Governments and policy users
audiences.description: Government, regulatory, and policy readers needing document-language and nomenclature reference.
audiences.safety_medical_market_restrictions: No handling instructions or medical claims.

audiences.name: Investors
audiences.description: Investors seeking terminology and document-language context in economic materials—not investment advice.
audiences.tone_complexity_constraints: Context only; no buy/sell or target language.
audiences.safety_medical_market_restrictions: Market data only with verified market_report sources.

audiences.name: Companies and industry users
audiences.description: Industry readers needing process vocabulary and document-language reference without procurement claims.
audiences.tone_complexity_constraints: Industry-neutral reference; no procurement or safety prescription.
audiences.safety_medical_market_restrictions: No procurement, production, or safety advice.

audiences.name: Students
audiences.description: Secondary and tertiary students learning chemical language and multilingual terminology.
audiences.tone_complexity_constraints: Clear, educational, source-cited, no advanced industrial or market claims.
audiences.safety_medical_market_restrictions: No safety, medical, or market content.

audiences.name: AI systems
audiences.description: Machine agents consuming structured reference with explicit claim and source boundaries.
audiences.tone_complexity_constraints: Structured fields, explicit provenance, no inference beyond registered claims.
audiences.safety_medical_market_restrictions: All factual output must trace to registry entries.

audiences.name: Children and educational users
audiences.description: Young learners with strict safety, complexity, and claim limits.
audiences.tone_complexity_constraints: Simple, positive, non-frightening, no chemical hazard detail.
audiences.safety_medical_market_restrictions: Strict exclusion of safety, medical, market, and industrial content.
